item.title: Saudi Arabia Gold price today: Gold falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices fell in Saudi Arabia on Thursday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: Pound Sterling Price News and Forecast: GBP/USD strengthens to around 1.3435 in the early European session
item.description: The GBP/USD pair gains ground to near 1.3435 during the early European session on Tuesday. The Pound Sterling (GBP) edges higher against the US Dollar (USD) as UK inflation rose more than expected in December. Markets might turn cautious later in the day ahead of a slew of US economic data.

item.title: USD/CHF holds onto Wednesday’s recovery move near 0.7950 in risk-on market
item.description: The USD/CHF pair clings to Wednesday’s recovery move near 0.7950 during the late Asian trading session on Thursday.

item.title: US Dollar Index stays silent near 99.00 ahead of GDP, PCE inflation data
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is maintaining its position after registering modest gains in the previous session. The DXY is trading around 98.80 during the Asian hours on Thursday.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Gathers strength to near 185.50, BoJ rate decision looms
item.description: The EUR/JPY cross attracts some buyers near 185.45 during the early European trading hours on Thursday. The Japanese Yen (JPY) strengthens against the Euro (EUR) on improved sentiment.

item.title: GBP/JPY rises to near 213.00 as Yen underperforms ahead of BoJ’s policy
item.description: The GBP/JPY pair trades 0.22% higher to near 213.10 at the start of the European trading session on Thursday. The pair gains as the Japanese Yen (JPY) underperforms across the board ahead of the monetary policy announcement by the Bank of Japan (BoJ) on Thursday.

item.title: Japanese Yen declines amid fiscal concerns and risk-on mood ahead of BoJ
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) slides to a one-week low against its American counterpart during the Asian session on Thursday and is pressured by a combination of negative factors.

item.title: USD/INR clings to gains as easing US-EU disputes boost US Dollar
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) holds onto losses near its all-time low against the US Dollar (USD) in the opening session on Thursday.

item.title: Gold recovers early lost ground; holds comfortably above $4,800 as traders look to US data
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) recovers a major part of Asian session losses on Thursday and currently trades around the $4,925 region, or nearly unchanged for the day amid mixed cues.
